#Business Analyst #Project Planning #JIRA #Agile #Scrum
Business Analyst with around 14+ years career in Information Technology (IT) within the
Corporate Banking Payments (ISO 20022), Collections and Receivables. (Cash Management
System) and Banking Products Pricing & Billing.
Adept in BA practices along with running workshops, requirements elicitation, handling
internal and external stakeholders
Proficient in creating documents - Functional Requirements documents, Impact Analysis
(IA), Gap Analysis, Use Case Documents, User Story, Non-Functional Requirement
Extensive work experience in SDLC, Agile, Waterfall methodology
Intense working experience in functional testing, system integration (SIT), User
acceptance (UAT), and writing complex SQL queries
Good understanding of business process flows and requirements management along with
excellent analytical, inter-personal, writing skills, facilitating meetings, backlog
management, business requirement elicitation, API features and data analysis
Exposure to Product Owner roles & responsibilities
Working experience on Collection and Receivable, Pricing and Billing and Corporate
Payments
Working experience on ISO 20022 payment message formats (PACS, PAIN &
Cancellation message formats)
Ensured adherence to industry standards and regulatory requirements, including 20022,
to maintain compliance and security in payment systems
Closely worked with stakeholders (Country local clearing, Operations, Compliance, IT,
Product) to understand the business and regulatory requirements and understand on how
new fields like UETR, structured remittance info, etc., affect internal systems
Documented detailed functional and non-functional requirements and analyze the impact
of ISO 20022 on existing system, formats (e.g., MT103
Pacs.008) and workflows
Created message mapping documents: MT to MX (e.g., MT101
Pain.001, MT103
Pacs.008) and work with XML schemas (XSDs) to validate the ISO 20022 message
structure and ensure compliance
Supported internal training for OPS/Tech teams on ISO message formats and flows and
acted as a subject matter expert (SME) for queries on ISO 20022 structure, tags, and
usage rules
